scope_notes: Queensland refineries, seaboard import terminals and port terminals only. Excluded: retail sites, airport JUHI/aviation depots, LPG terminals, bitumen terminals (Puma, Pinkenba/Townsville), small distributor depots (about 50 in the GA depot layer), Quantem Pinkenba (bulk chemicals and oils; unclear whether it still handles fuel after importer Freedom Fuels left in Jan 2026), QAL South Trees wharf (industrial bunker fuel), Northern Oil Yarwun (used-oil re-refinery), and decommissioned terminals (Bundaberg/Burnett Heads, Karumba, Tropic Distributors Townsville). The closed Bulwer Island refinery is not listed separately because it is now the BP Bulwer terminal site.

sites.name: Ampol Lytton Refinery
sites.note: Queensland's only remaining crude oil refinery (~109,000 bbl/day), supplying petrol, diesel and jet fuel to south-east Queensland.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 613182101 "Ampol Oil Refinery" (Overpass). Cross-checked against GA Liquid_Fuel_Refineries (-27.41426,153.15942, ~250 m) and NPI (-27.40848,153.15408, office point ~600 m).

sites.name: Ampol Lytton Terminal
sites.note: Ampol product terminal at 1 Tanker St beside the refinery; road-tanker loading 24/7.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates for "Ampol Terminal Lytton" (Tanker St off Port Dr). GA Liquid_Fuel_Terminals "Lytton" (Caltex) is ~320 m away.

sites.name: IOR Lytton Terminal
sites.note: Diesel-only import and storage terminal (commissioned 2023), one of the largest diesel-only terminals on Australia's east coast; imports via Fisherman Islands.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 1542807213 "IOR Lytton Fuel Terminal"; NPI "Lytton Terminal" (Lytton Terminals Pty Ltd, cnr Port Dr & Tanker St) is within 20 m.

sites.name: BP Bulwer Island Terminal (Bulwer Jet Terminal)
sites.operator: BP (operated by ATOM, a BP/UGL joint venture)
sites.note: Former BP Bulwer Island refinery (closed 2014-15), converted to an import terminal in July 2015; stores jet fuel, petrol and diesel; lease extended to 2061 with ~54 ML more storage planned by 2029.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 31046232 "BP Oil terminal". NPI "Bulwer Jet Terminal" (398 Tingira St) is ~110 m away; GA terminal point ~400 m.

sites.name: BP Kirra Street Terminal
sites.note: Satellite storage of the Bulwer Jet Terminal at 4 Kirra St (bulk diesel tank plus wharf/pipeline links).
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates for "Kirra Street Terminal"; Nominatim puts Kirra Street centre at -27.41696,153.13659 (~100 m). Single coordinate source.

sites.name: Viva Energy Pinkenba Terminal
sites.note: Riverside import/storage terminal (since 1958) for petrol, diesel and jet fuel, with a jet-fuel pipeline to Brisbane Airport and a large lubricants plant.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM relation 11256049 "Viva Energy Australia". GA (Shell, 385 Eagle Farm Rd) within 40 m; NPI point ~200 m.

sites.name: BP Whinstanes Terminal
sites.note: BP fuel storage and distribution terminal at 701 Kingsford Smith Dr.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 22774327 "BP Whinstanes Terminal"; GA and NPI points both within 20 m.

sites.name: Chevron Eagle Farm Terminal
sites.note: Chevron's Brisbane fuel import terminal at 23 Theodore St, acquired with Puma Energy Australia in 2020.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 22774374 "Chevron Australia Downstream Eagle Farm Fuel Terminal"; GA (Neumann) and NPI points within 60 m.

sites.name: Ampol Cairns Terminal
sites.note: Ampol seaboard fuel terminal at 60-68 Draper St serving Far North Queensland.
sites.coordinates_source: GA Liquid_Fuel_Terminals point (Caltex, 60 Draper St, spatial confidence 5), matching Ampol's listed address and an OSM storage-tank cluster. NPI point (13-25 Kenny St) is ~340 m away.

sites.name: BP Cairns Terminal
sites.note: BP seaboard fuel terminal on Kenny St.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates ("Cairns Terminal", 33 Kenny St). GA BP point (11-33 Kenny St) is ~160 m away; both sit on the OSM tank farm.

sites.name: Viva Energy Cairns Terminal
sites.note: Viva Energy seaboard fuel terminal at the corner of Kenny and Draper Sts.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; GA (Shell, 52-56 Kenny St) within 25 m; OSM storage tanks present at the site.

sites.name: Viva Energy Townsville Terminal
sites.note: Viva Energy seaboard fuel terminal on Hubert St.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates. GA (Shell, Hubert St) is ~220 m east; several terminals adjoin here, so allow ~300 m.

sites.name: BP Townsville Terminal
sites.note: BP seaboard fuel terminal at 94 Hubert St.
sites.coordinates_source: GA Liquid_Fuel_Terminals point (94 Hubert St, spatial confidence 5, revised 2020), on an OSM storage-tank cluster. The NPI point falls on the Hubert St road ~480 m south, so it was not used.

sites.name: Chevron Townsville Port Bulk Fuel Facility
sites.note: Ex-Puma import terminal, opened about 2015, at 125 Hubert St; two sites linked by pipelines (expanded 2024).
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; lies within the OSM storage-tank cluster east of Hubert St. Single coordinate source.

sites.name: Ampol Mackay Terminal
sites.note: Ampol seaboard fuel terminal on Harbour Rd / Hamilton Dr, Mackay outer harbour.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; GA (Caltex, Harbour Rd) within 25 m.

sites.name: Viva Energy Mackay Terminal
sites.note: Viva Energy seaboard fuel terminal on Hamilton Dr.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; GA (Shell, Hamilton Dr) within 25 m.

sites.name: BP Mackay Terminal
sites.note: BP seaboard fuel terminal on Graeme Heggie St.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates (Graeme Heggie St). GA BP point on the same street is ~240 m away.

sites.name: Chevron Mackay Terminal
sites.note: Ex-Puma fuel import terminal at 115 Spiller Ave, opened by Puma about 2014-15.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; Nominatim reverse places it at Edmund Casey Dr / Spiller Ave, Mackay Harbour. Single source; OSM has no tanks mapped here.
sites.uncertain: United Petroleum says it recently bought "our Mackay Import Terminal"; it is not confirmed whether that is this site or the former BB Energy (Pioneer Energy) diesel terminal.

sites.name: United Petroleum Mackay Terminal
sites.note: Recently acquired 78 ML import terminal with dual ship pipelines and ethanol-blend capability (probably the former BB Energy/Pioneer Energy 3 x 25 ML diesel terminal).
sites.coordinates_source: Site not located. Coordinates are the centre of OSM way 177802443 "Port of Mackay" (port precinct), used as a placeholder.
sites.uncertain: Exact site and previous owner are unconfirmed; it may be the same facility as the Chevron Mackay Terminal.

sites.name: Ampol Gladstone Terminal
sites.note: Ampol seaboard fuel terminal on Strokarck St serving Central Queensland.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; GA (Caltex) ~55 m; Strokarck St (Nominatim) and an OSM tank cluster adjoin.

sites.name: BP Gladstone Terminal
sites.note: BP seaboard fuel terminal on McLintock St.
sites.coordinates_source: NPI 2024/25 reported coordinates; GA (12 McLintock St) within 95 m; OSM storage tanks present.

sites.name: Port Alma Bulk Fuel Terminal
sites.operator: Unconfirmed (sold by Stolthaven to an undisclosed private buyer in 2022)
sites.note: Bulk liquids terminal at Port Alma (berth PA3 handles fuel and tallow); United Petroleum publishes a diesel terminal gate price for Port Alma.
sites.coordinates_source: GA Liquid_Fuel_Terminals point (Stolthaven, Port Alma Rd, spatial confidence 5, revised 2012). Nominatim reverse confirms Port Alma Rd. Not cross-checked against OSM tanks (none mapped).
sites.uncertain: Current operator is unknown and the GA record dates from 2012.

sites.name: Weipa Fuel Terminal
sites.note: Seaboard fuel terminal supplying Rio Tinto's Weipa bauxite operations and western Cape York; Viva Energy publishes a Weipa terminal gate price.
sites.coordinates_source: Centroid of 5 OSM storage-tank ways on Kerr Point Dr (Overpass). NPI (2 Toots Holzheimer Rd) is ~500 m NE and GA (BP-era, low confidence 2) is ~100 m W.

sites.name: IOR Eromanga Refinery
sites.note: Small inland refinery that turns local Cooper/Eromanga Basin crude into diesel and other products for western Queensland.
sites.coordinates_source: Centre of OSM way 98116772 "IOR Petroleum Oil Refinery"; NPI point (Webber St) within 70 m.
